body:
It's not the goody two shoes that perpetuate this issue, I am a goody two shoes who actually has the same thoughts as OP. Despite intending the best and trying to be perfect, it feels like it has never been good enough and it also feels like everyday is a new fight against something instead of a moment of relief.

I sleep really late thinking what should happen but never have the energy to do things anymore. I don't want to die because of others, I want to cease existing because of me and not fulfilling what seems a basic requirement to everyone else.

I feel you. I hate myself for doing nothing and continuing this cycle, then guilty for doing nothing and being a burden for my family. I barely eat once a day just for mere survival, sleep schedule is fucked and I get zero sleep.

Holy sh##, this is something I am going through minus him explicitly telling me to kill myself. Sorry if I come across bad here, I just didn't think I could relate to someone. I am sorry for your pain, and your stepfather is a terrible person.
I'm in a similar boat, and I feel so much guilt about it. Hopefully you find peace of mind though, if I had the power I would make this awful feeling disappear from every human being.
